arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Goal: settle at about critical power (pod ~162 W, check it) after the hard start, keep the pod reserve near 30-50 pct until ~1.5 km to go, then finish sprint to empty it. Check CP: heart rate should level off at a steady effort below CP. Watch for incidents: weed on rudder (speed per pod watt drops suddenly -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power vs HR/GPS disagree), radio course change (set_race_distance), wind/current shift. Use watches + legs() + measure().
